errors.evidence: In the description of the 'end' (purple) line, this phrasing omits the initial dip at the 'mb' data point. The line starts at ~0.51 ('bb'), dips to ~0.48 ('mb'), and then rises sharply to ~0.83 ('cf'). By skipping the 'mb' point, the description simplifies a dip-and-spike movement into just a spike, which misrepresents the line's behavior in that segment.
